title: 中心论点的限定
goal: 选择明确回答任务的中心论点；限定论点的对象和适用范围。

points.label: 选择明确回答任务的中心论点
限定论点的对象和适用范围

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分本课的内容范围、知识点及教学材料规格

sources.title: C2 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 依据所给研究文件中的写作语言与连贯性要求安排教学，不陈述考试事实

body.p: 中心论点明确回答任务提出的问题，包含三部分：讨论对象、作者立场、适用范围。主题词只说明讨论的领域。事实陈述只提供背景，不是论点。

body.box: The college should offer optional evening workshops for students who cannot attend daytime sessions.

body.p: college 是行动主体，should offer 表明支持开设。optional 和 students who cannot attend daytime sessions 限定了安排和对象。论点要能由后文的理由支撑，不用 always、everyone 扩大范围。

cards.title: 主题与论点
rows: 主题词
只说出领域，没有立场。
Evening workshops for students with daytime classes
事实陈述
可以作背景，但没有回答是否应该开设。
The college currently offers several practical workshops during the afternoon on most weekdays.
明确立场
直接回答任务问的是否、应当，不只宣布要讨论。
The college should add evening workshops for students whose courses occupy the afternoon.
讨论对象
写明谁来做、针对什么事。
The student union should offer short orientation walks for new members of campus clubs.
适用范围
限定人群、场景或条件，立场仍然清楚。
Optional evening sessions may help students with daytime jobs attend practical training more regularly.
立场一致
结尾可以换说法，立场要与开头一致。
Evening access should therefore remain an option for students unable to attend daytime workshops.

cards.title: 宽泛论点与限定论点
rows: 所有课程一律采用
All courses should replace lectures with group discussions throughout the entire academic year.
Introductory literature courses should include small discussions after students have completed the assigned reading.
效果绝对化
Online notes always improve the academic performance of every student in every subject.
Online notes can help absent students review the main points of an introductory lecture.
行为一律强制
Every student should volunteer every weekend regardless of other responsibilities or personal circumstances.
Colleges should offer flexible volunteer projects for students who can commit a few hours monthly.
对象无限扩大
All residents should use shared kitchens for every meal throughout the working week.
New residence halls should provide shared kitchens for students who prefer preparing some meals.
范围超过理由
All examinations should disappear because students sometimes feel nervous before a timed test.
Courses with practical projects should consider using project work alongside exams to assess different skills.
条件未经限定
Peer advice is always better than professional guidance for every possible study problem.
Peer advice can help first-year students understand routine campus procedures alongside official guidance.

body.box: Task: Discuss whether a college should lend basic tools to students living in residence halls. Notes: Some students need tools only for occasional repairs. Staff can check each returned set. The service would not cover complex electrical work.

body.p: 主题词 tool lending 没有立场，The college owns tools 只是事实。论点应支持小范围借用，并保留 basic 和 occasional repairs 这两个限定。

body.box: The college should lend basic tools to residence students for occasional repairs under staff supervision.

body.p: 这个论点没有保证所有维修都能完成。结尾如果改成 Students should handle all repairs without supervision，就扩大了范围，也去掉了原有的限定。

items.stem: Task: Recommend optional practice interviews for graduating students. Which thesis answers the task?
options: Most graduating students attend several job interviews during their final year of study.
Colleges should offer optional practice interviews to graduating students.
This essay will describe the practice interviews attended by graduating students.
Practice interviews and the interview experiences of graduating students.
items.why: 第二项以 should offer 明确建议，同时保留 optional 和 graduating students。

items.stem: Notes support better access for wheelchair users at one entrance. Which claim keeps that scope?
options: Every entrance already provides equal access for every visitor.
The entire campus must be rebuilt for all possible needs.
A ramp at the east entrance could improve wheelchair access.
A ramp will remove every access difficulty across the campus.
items.why: one entrance 和 wheelchair users 限定了范围。第三项只说东门，并用 could 表示可能。

items.stem: Opening: Short book reviews should remain optional. Which ending keeps that position?
options: The course should retain book reviews as an optional activity.
Every student must submit a short book review for the course each week.
Book reviews should replace all required course assignments.
The course should remove the option of writing reviews.
items.why: remain optional 与第一项的 retain ... as an optional activity 一致。第四项取消了选择，立场相反。

items.stem: Evidence concerns first-year commuters. Which phrase narrows the claim to the supported group?
options: every student at every college in the country
all residents of the communities near the campus
students of every year who travel to campus
first-year students who travel to the campus
items.why: first-year commuters 对应 first-year students who travel to the campus，即第四项。第三项把范围扩大到了所有年级。

groups.text: A fieldwork department is considering whether to keep printed guides. Several students find paper copies useful when their phones lose power outdoors. Digital copies are more convenient for others. The department has enough funds to keep a small stock of printed guides, so the proposal is to retain a choice.

items.stem: Complete the recommendation with the stated optional status.
items.why: should retain the option 表示保留选择，与材料的 retain a choice 一致。

items.stem: Choose from all / some / no: The evidence supports printed guides for ___ students, not for every student.
items.why: Several students 需要纸质版，others 觉得电子版更方便，所以只能填 some。

groups.text: A project course collects draft plans before students start their final work. The tutor proposes optional revision meetings for those who want feedback. A short conversation can clarify an unclear plan, but written guidance remains available to everyone. The proposal does not require daily attendance or promise that every project will succeed.

items.stem: Which thesis directly supports the proposal described in the notes?
options: The course should offer optional revision meetings for students seeking feedback on draft plans.
The course already collects draft plans from students before they begin the final project.
This essay will describe the meetings and feedback offered during the planning stages of the course.
The course should require every student to attend daily meetings throughout the final project.
items.why: optional revision meetings for those who want feedback 是提案的内容，第一项照原样保留。第四项把自愿参加改成了每天必须参加。

items.stem: Which phrase keeps the proposed benefit within the evidence?
options: guarantees successful projects for every student
may clarify draft plans for interested students
replaces all written guidance for project work
removes every difficulty throughout the whole course
items.why: can clarify an unclear plan 只说明会面能帮助理清计划，即第二项。第一项的 guarantees 超出了材料。

items.stem: State the proposal while keeping participation optional.
items.why: the option of attending 表示自愿参加，与材料立场一致。

items.stem: Choose from all / interested / absent: The proposed meetings are intended for ___ students who want feedback.
items.why: 材料写的是 those who want feedback，即想要反馈的学生，所以填 interested。

groups.text: A club tried a small refundable deposit for a single pottery session with limited places. It reported fewer late cancellations at that session. The writer supports considering this approach for similar optional events, provided that refund terms are clear. The writer does not recommend deposits for every campus activity.

items.stem: Which conclusion preserves the writer’s position?
options: Every club event should require a refundable deposit from every participant.
Deposits should be removed from all events with limited places.
Optional events with limited places may use small refundable deposits.
A deposit system will prevent every cancellation at every event.
items.why: 作者只支持 similar optional events，押金是 small、refundable。第三项保留了这些限定。

items.stem: Which claim exceeds the scope of the supporting example?
options: A refundable deposit may reduce late cancellations at a limited event.
Clear refund terms can protect students whose circumstances suddenly change.
A small deposit is worth considering for some optional club events.
Deposits will eliminate cancellations across every activity on the campus.
items.why: 依据只是 a single pottery session 的 fewer late cancellations。第四项扩大到 every activity，又把减少写成 eliminate，超出了依据。

items.stem: Complete the limited claim about the deposit scheme.
items.why: may reduce 表示可能减少，of late cancellations 说明减少的是什么。eliminates 是完全消除，超出了依据。

items.stem: Choose from limited / universal / opposing: Support for deposits only at selected optional events is a ___ position.
items.why: only at selected optional events 限定了适用范围，所以是 limited。
